description: This file defines type aliases for use within a TypeScript project, specifically defining a generic Setter function type and an EmailEvent type alias for string.

methods.name: Setter
methods.description: A generic type alias for a setter function that updates a state value of type T, accepting either a new value or an updater function.

methods.name: EmailEvent
methods.description: Type alias for string representing different email event types fetched from an API endpoint.

ctags.name: Setter
ctags.pattern: /^export type Setter<T> = (newValueOrUpdater: T | ((previousValue: T) => T)) => void;$/
